verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents free-trial support: the SDK checks eligibility for introductory offers, and on Apple and Amazon stores a free trial is applied automatically at purchase. It also lets you grant promotional entitlements. However, the pack has no evidence of coupons or promotion-code redemption, documented automatic trial-to-paid conversion, or card-network trial-end reminders, and a community feature request asks for reminders before a trial expires. Missing for 10: coupon/promotion-code support, documented automatic trial-to-paid conversion, card-network-compliant trial-end notifications, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules

citations.quote: when an eligible user attempts to purchase a product that has an introductory offer (e.g. a free trial) the offer will be applied automatically.
The Purchases SDK allows for easy checking of eligibility for introductory offers on iOS
